title: Evaluation of the configuration circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and binary input and output, let $n,T\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources valid for $n$ input bits, and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. Form the binary word $y$ by evaluating each source in $\ell$ on $x$. The configuration circuit built from $M, n,\ell,T$ evaluates to true exactly when, at some time $s<T$ in the run of $M$ on $y$, the transition from the machine's snapshot emits the bit $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Each source in $\ell$ is valid for $n$ input bits, the configuration width, and instruction index $0$
The machine $M$, source list $\ell$, and time bound $T$ are parameters
